# print_blocking_accessible_coarse_overlap_comparison { #mofography.raspa_helper.print_blocking_accessible_coarse_overlap_comparison }

```python
raspa_helper.print_blocking_accessible_coarse_overlap_comparison(
    stats_by_method,
    *,
    title='Coarse accessible overlap — method comparison',
)
```

Compare outputs of :func:`blocking_spheres_overlap_accessible_coarse_sample`
for several blocking builders (e.g. largest-including vs greedy).



## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

stats_by_method : dict
    Maps method name (str) -> stats dict from
    :func:`blocking_spheres_overlap_accessible_coarse_sample`.
